summary: Preserved PR 1608's valid eager and graph row-chunking fixes and corrected the independently reproduced graph counterexample by capping the graph-safe MQA-logits allocation budget at 512 MiB. At the issue dimensions the exact candidate used a 1.6 GiB budget and left the 1.421875 GiB allocation whole; the consolidated correction plans 1440-row chunks of about 500 MiB.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before at exact candidate c0d54de: graph_budget=1717986918, issue_allocation=1526726656, rows_per_chunk=None.
Passing-after: graph_budget=536870912, issue_allocation=1526726656, rows_per_chunk=1440; each chunk is below the issue-reported 1.17 GiB live free memory.
21 focused tests and 29 subtests passed, covering budget arithmetic, graph/eager modes, paged/nonpaged planning, and chunk equivalence.

tests.command: inline torch GPU top-k equivalence check on cuda device
tests.what_was_measured: On AMD Instinct MI350X, unchunked output matched row chunks 1, 3, 7, 16, and 40 for selected top-k page sets.

gpu_execution.evidence: Actual AMD Instinct MI350X/gfx950 ROCm 7.2 execution validated row-wise top-k equivalence; it was not a DeepSeek-V4 model or CUDA DeepGEMM run.

remaining_limitations: The environment has one AMD Instinct MI350X under ROCm 7.2, not the reported four H100 CUDA 12.9 topology.
